{{short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Randi Holmestad''' is a Norwegian physicist and a professor at the Department of Physics at the [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]]. She is known for her work in materials physics, focusing primarily on the relationship between microstructure and macroscopic properties in various materials. Her research has contributed to fields such as [[transmission electron microscopy]], [[electron diffraction]], and the study of [[Aluminium alloy|aluminum alloys]], solar cell materials, and new functional materials.

== Education and career ==
Holmestad studied at the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]], where she earned her Master of Science (Siv. ing.) degree in Technical Physics in 1991, followed by a PhD in [[Materials science|Materials Physics]] in 1994. Her doctoral dissertation focused on [[transmission electron microscopy]] and its application to the study of materials microstructure. After postdoctoral work at the Norwegian Institute of Technology, Holmestad worked at [[SINTEF]], a Norwegian research institute, from 1995 until 1996. She became a professor at the [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]] in 1999.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae, Randi Holmestad, May 2012. |url=https://randih.folk.ntnu.no/CVRandi_4p_last2.pdf |website=NTNU}}</ref>

Holmestad was the project leader for the Norwegian Centre of Transmission Electron Microscopy (NORTEM) from 2010 until 2013, and then again starting in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Collett |first=Albert H. |date=15 September 2015 |title=New Girl on the Block |url=https://sfi-casa.no/randi-holmestad-profile/ |website=Centre for Advanced Structural Analysis}}</ref> She is also a part of the ESTEEM3 project where she links academia and industry partners in the use of electron microscopy for industrial applications.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 September 2019 |title=ESTEEM3 Interviews: Dr. Randi Holmestad from NTNU Trondheim, Norway |url=https://www.esteem3.eu/news?backRef=213&news=Interviews_Randi_Holmestad_NTNU |access-date=2024-12-19 |website=www.esteem3.eu}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
In 2006 Holmestad was elected a member of [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]] (Norges Tekniske Vitenskapsakademi).<ref name=":1" /> She was elected a member of the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]] (Det Kongelige Norske Videnskabers Selskab) in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gruppe II Fysikk |url=https://www.dknvs.no/akademiet/medlemmer/gruppe-ii-fysikk/ |access-date=2025-08-04 |website=DKNVS |language=nb-NO}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=2016 |title=The Royal Norwegian Science Society Yearbook |url=https://www.dknvs.no/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/DKNVS_Aarbok16_Web_Scr.pdf |access-date=2024-12-11 |website=www.dknvs.no |language=Norwegian}}</ref>
